title: Components & Routes
summary: App = reusable Components + Routes — edit once, update everywhere

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Introduction to the Lesson
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** **The app = reusable small pieces (Components) + pages with titles (Routes)**.
- **Why now?** **The depth of Builder is optional** — **but if you are building a product, this lesson prevents repeating the same code on every page**.
- **What after the lesson?** **You will define 3 components and 3 pages for your app** — **before any code**.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: A blue button here and a green one there — the app looks messy
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Each page looks a bit different**. **The submit button is blue in chat and green in settings**.
- **The problem: You repeated the same code by copying and pasting**. **Any small change = a change in the entire app**.
- **The solution: Build the component once and use it everywhere**.

sections.heading: Core idea
sections.subtitle: A reusable piece + a route for each page
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Component = a small lego piece**: **a button, a message bubble, a chat card**. **You design it once and use it with different data (Props)**.
- **Route = the complete page that has a title in the browser** — **like `/chat` or `/settings`**.
- **The page itself is a large component that combines smaller components**. **Rule: Each component does one thing only**.

sections.heading: Comparison
sections.subtitle: Code repetition vs. the 3 times rule
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Error — same design in 3 places | Correct — Component once |
|----------------------------|---------------------------|
| **Repeated the user message design in 3 places**. **Change the font size — forget one place — the interface breaks** | **The third time: stop — create a separate Component**. **Change once — it reflects everywhere** |

sections.subtitle: Terms for the interface

| **Component** | **A piece of the interface written once and used multiple times with different data** | **`ChatBubble` — once sender=User and once sender=AI, same template** |

sections.heading: Screenshot block (intent)
sections.contentMarkdown: **Any professional interface looks complex** — **but it is a repetition of 3-4 templates**. **ModuleCard and LessonRow = Components that repeat with different data**.

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Quick confirmation
sections.contentMarkdown:
> **Quiz key:** correctIndex: 0

**Question:** **You need a card for each previous conversation — a title, summary, and date. What is the best way?**

**One Component `ConversationCard` — pass the data for each conversation as Props**.
A new Component for each conversation: `ConversationCard1`, `ConversationCard2`...****
Combine all cards into one large component `HistoryPage`.

**Explanation:** **A Component is written once and used with different data** — **it reduces repetition and makes changes in one place**.

sections.heading: Mission
sections.subtitle: Define 3 components and 3 pages
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **Before any code — plan on paper**. **10-15 minutes**.

**Delivery:**

1. **3 pages (Routes)** — **a route + a goal for each one**
2. **3 Components** — **name + Props + in which page/pages it appears**
3. **Does the component need internal memory (state)?** **Which one and why?**

**Evaluation criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| 3 clear pages | 50% | **Each Route has a path and a goal**. **The pages cover the main customer journey** |
| 3 Components with Props | 50% | **Each Component has a name and defined Props**. **Clearly stated where it appears** |
